title: Stockroom Control over Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements Pieces: Booking, Reservation, Substitution and Price Protection
content:
# Stockroom control — held pieces under Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements

The merchandise held under an agreement of Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements is booked to the agreement as one entry per piece held, carrying the receipt reference and the item reference it was rung under. Merchandise is booked to an agreement only while that agreement stands at opened, current or on hold. A piece is set aside in the stockroom when the agreement is opened and stays set aside for as long as the agreement runs. A piece is swapped for another only on the plans that admit substitution, and only where the substituted piece's price is within the plan's tolerance of the original. Where the ticket price falls inside the plan's price protection window after opening, the fall is passed on to the customer and the balance rebuilt at the lower price.

## Points of judgement

- **One entry per piece.** Two pieces held under one agreement are two entries, each with the receipt reference and item reference it was rung under.
- **Standing of the agreement.** Whether merchandise may be booked is read from the agreement's standing on its record, matched on the agreement reference, before the booking is made. At opened, current or on hold it may be booked; at delinquent, completed, forfeited or cancelled it may not.
- **Reservation.** The piece is set aside at opening and remains set aside for the run of the agreement.
- **Substitution.** Two conditions, both of which must hold: the plan admits substitution, and the substituted piece's price differs from the original piece's price by no more than the plan's tolerance, read as a share of the original price.
- **Price protection.** A fall in the ticket price within the plan's window of calendar days after opening is passed on, and the balance is rebuilt at the lower price.

## Substitution on a hypothetical tolerance

With a tolerance of, hypothetically, 15 percent and an original piece priced at 1000.00, a substituted piece priced anywhere from 850.00 to 1150.00 is within tolerance, a piece at 1150.00 sitting exactly at the limit and still within it; a piece at 1150.01 or at 849.99 is outside it and is not swapped in. On a plan that admits no substitution, no piece is swapped in at any price.
